exampleDiffers.images: https://docs.tavily.com/sdk/javascript/reference.md response-format sample illustrates optional images. Its own table and https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search.md make images conditional on includeImages/include_images, default false. This unmodified simple query correctly has an empty images list, asserted by the replay.
exampleDiffers.results[].images: https://docs.tavily.com/sdk/javascript/reference.md describes result images as optional, only included with includeImages:true; https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search.md defaults include_images:false. The sample illustrates the option; this simple request omits it, asserted by the replay.
exampleDiffers.results[].favicon: https://docs.tavily.com/sdk/javascript/reference.md marks favicon optional and defaults includeFavicon:false; https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search.md defaults include_favicon:false. The sample illustrates the optional field; this simple request omits it, asserted by the replay.
exampleDiffers.responseTime: https://docs.tavily.com/sdk/javascript/reference.md names the SDK response field responseTime; https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search.md publishes HTTP response_time. Architecture Published examples requires the spec wire and records remaining page/spec shape differences; the replay asserts response_time.
exampleDiffers.requestId: https://docs.tavily.com/sdk/javascript/reference.md names the SDK response field requestId; https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search.md publishes HTTP request_id. Architecture Published examples requires the spec wire and records remaining page/spec shape differences; the replay asserts request_id.

exampleDiffers.results[].favicon: https://docs.tavily.com/sdk/javascript/reference.md response-format sample illustrates the optional favicon, and its table and https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/extract.md default includeFavicon/include_favicon:false. The published request enables images only; replay asserts those images and the absent favicon.

notReplayed.search#doc Rendered full search request: https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search publishes include_domains:[] together with an explicit include_domains_mode:restrict, while https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search.md states setting include_domains_mode without include_domains returns 400. Its response also contains answer, favicon, per-result images, dates, usage and auto_parameters despite false request flags; the endpoint descriptions require those options to be enabled. This is the vendor renderer contradicting the vendor options, not a missing World precondition.
notReplayed.extract#doc Rendered full extract reques: https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/extract publishes timeout:"None" in its generated curl JSON. https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/extract.md declares timeout a number between 1 and 60, with absence choosing 10/30 by depth. The generated request contradicts the vendor type; its response also includes an unrequested favicon while include_favicon is false.
